narrative.narrative: Bybit shed 105.1 million dollars over 24 hours after taking in 43.3 million, while exchanges overall took in 232.5 million dollars, 0.0866 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 294.0 million dollars and 0.1091 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a negative print means money left the place where holders can sell, and Bybit's print changed from an intake to an outflow. Binance took in 369.9 million dollars, while Bitfinex shed 64.9 million and Bitget shed 49.8 million.
